An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<div><span data-as="p">First</span><span data-as="p">Second</span></div>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(data_as_elements: []))
puts result.content.inspect
```
